_comment: FALLBACK ONLY — you normally never touch this file.
Use it if the daily email fails with a permission error AND running setupTrigger()
never shows an authorization dialog. That combination means your project pins its
scopes explicitly, so Apps Script will not add a missing one by itself.
In the Apps Script editor: Project Settings (gear) -> tick 'Show appsscript.json manifest
file in editor' -> open appsscript.json -> paste the oauthScopes array below into it,
keeping your own timeZone value -> Save -> run setupTrigger() -> accept the prompt ->
Deploy -> Manage deployments -> pencil -> New version -> Deploy.
Each scope maps to something this v6 (email-only) script actually does:
script.send_mail   send the daily mini-lesson email (MailApp)
script.scriptapp   install and read the daily trigger (ScriptApp)
userinfo.email     know the owner's address, used by sendTestEmail()
